citation: Pesaresi M., Politis P. (2023), GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, European Commission Joint Research Centre
definition: Binary cell selection: 2020 building-covered surface >= 50000 square metres per 1000000-square-metre cell. Residential and non-residential buildings included. No smoothing or invented expansion.
limitations: Generalized satellite-derived reference, not a legal urban boundary or individual building footprints. Small/sparse settlements may not meet the threshold. 2020 values are modelled from the multitemporal GHSL series.
